payload.goal: Reference for NVIDIA Hopper (H20 / H100 / H200 / SM90): CuTeDSL SM90 (Hopper) Special Features
payload.title: CuTeDSL SM90 (Hopper) Special Features
payload.summary: Hopper introduces **warpgroup-level** MMA (128 threads = 4 warps collaboration), implemented via WGMMA instructions.

sections.heading: Warpgroup MMA (WGMMA)
sections.gist: Hopper introduces **warpgroup-level** MMA (128 threads = 4 warps collaboration), implemented via WGMMA instructions.

sections.heading: SmemLayoutAtomKind
sections.gist: SM90's SMEM layout atom is the "minimal compact layout that satisfies TMA and UMMA legality," used recoveryto construct the SMEM layout for operands A/B via blocked product.

sections.heading: TMA (Tensor Memory Accelerator)
sections.gist: TMA is a hardware data movement unit in the Hopper architecture.

sections.heading: PipelineTmaAsync — SM90 Mainloop Pipeline
sections.gist: Key characteristics: - Producer `commit` is a noop — TMA instructions automatically update transaction count - Consumer `release` conditionally sends empty buffer signal - Internally computes multicast signaling threads automatically

sections.heading: Warp-Level ldmatrix/stmatrix
sections.gist: `LdMatrix16x8x8bOp` has no direct PTX counterpart—it lowers to `.m16n16` ldmatrix with additional address/value rearrangement, used for vectorized Ampere-style 8x8 matrix thread-value layouts.

    num_stages=4,
